heading: Hyderabad results
author: Racing Correspondent
paragraphs: Trainer Neelesh Rawal’s colt Hanumanmahabala, ridden by Neeraj Rawal, won the Raja Mahboob Karan Memorial Trophy, the main event of Monday’s (Sept. 21) races.
The winner is owned by M/s. Balam Mohla, Kishore M. Dingra, Vara Prasad Reddy & The Estate of Late Mr. Sultan Singh.
